body.name: finite continuum-certificate representation
body.construction: A certificate is the finite tuple \(\Gamma=(K,h,\{Q_j,A_j\}_{j=1}^J,\{R_r\}_{r=1}^R,E,W,U_\varepsilon,b_\varepsilon,\delta_{\mathrm{enc}})\). Each \(Q_j\) is a rational polyhedron in the observable coordinates \(s\) and known \(\kappa\), the closed cells have disjoint interiors and cover \(\mathcal S_T\times\mathcal K\), and \(A_j:\mathcal B_K\to\{[a,c]:a,c\in\mathcal G_h,\ a\le c\}\) is a total endpoint-grid policy table, with \(\Theta\) reported outside \(\mathcal B_K\). The rational polyhedra \(R_r\) cover every \(Q_j\) crossed with the maintained \(A,b,v\) boxes. The finite record \(E\) contains outward-rounded rational enclosures for Poisson recurrences, exponential factors, cellwise target membership, coverage, risk, and the uniform count tail. The witness \(W\) contains a rational finite nuisance support, the induced integer policy program, an integral incumbent, and a complete exact branch-and-bound tree whose every leaf is either integral or carries a checkable rational dual bound; no root-relaxation value is accepted as \(b_\varepsilon\).
